title: LLM-based fault detection and root-cause analysis for Kubernetes: code, records and protocol of a pre-registered evaluation
description: Code, records and protocol accompanying the manuscript "LLM-based fault detection and root-cause analysis for Kubernetes: a pre-registered evaluation of what the model contributes". Includes the complete system (telemetry collectors, context builder, LLM agent, remediation gating, fault injection), 330 recorded monitoring cycles, the annotation-ablation and multi-model replays, non-LLM baselines, rule-based and blinded root-cause scoring, and the protocol with its four amendments. Code is MIT-licensed; data are CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA).
